en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a central European town square, with several figures in period clothing (likely late 19th to early 20th century) standing or walking in an open cobbled plaza. The backdrop features a row of multi-story buildings with ornate facades, including signs for 'Hotel zum goldnen Löwen' and 'Hotel zum goldnen Kegel.' There is prominent decorative architecture above the hotel entrances. The text on the card is in German, written in a typeface common in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
